why_not: The candidate is a score-test entry rule implemented inside the C++ stepwise kernels (kk21_weights.cpp, as kk21_stepwise_logistic_weights_cpp does); no exported EDI function does score-based stepwise for beta/NB/ordinal, and an R-level stand-in (glm.fit + statmod::glm.scoretest per step) would time R loops against C++ refits, so its verdict would measure language, not algorithm. It is also an estimator change (score z vs Wald t changes the selected order and weights), so the two sides cannot agree under any tier; the speed claim needs the v1.2.0-TODO-23 code first.
